stories.title: Clinical Trial Snapshot Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and validate the canonical trial snapshot schema (phase, status, summary, eligibility, locations, URL) and enforce contract alignment between Pydantic models and domain service output.

stories.title: Clinical Trial Data Extraction and Mapping Logic
stories.description: Implement and normalize extraction of trial attributes from ClinicalTrials.gov responses, including handling missing fields, formatting eligibility text, and standardizing location structures.

stories.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration for Trial Snapshot
stories.description: Integrate structured trial snapshot into evaluate_care_facade, ensuring compatibility with tool_router, consistent response formatting, and inclusion in chat responses.

stories.title: Frontend Rendering of Clinical Trial Snapshot
stories.description: Render structured trial data in chat UI with clear labeling, readable eligibility formatting, location display, and safe clickable URLs using existing markdown and URL validation pipeline.

stories.title: Clinical Trial Snapshot Tests and Integration Validation
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering schema validation, extraction accuracy, facade integration, and end-to-end rendering including URL safety and fallback handling for incomplete data.
